title: לעשות דבר אחד
emotional_truth: creating something small, however imperfect, beats consuming something perfect; making is how you leave a mark on your own day

forbidden: judging the quality of what was made
safety.notes: The making is the whole point, never the result. 'Imperfect' is safe and welcome. Sharing is optional and consent-first. Success is the attempt, never how good it turned out.
